result: Eén geïnstalleerde productingang met zes duidelijke secties gebruikt Eva’s bestaande gesprek-, personen-/geheugen-, taak-, initiatief- en verbindingsroutes. Het projectdashboard blijft apart.

userAccess.access: Existing local owner gateway, no manually entered dashboard token
userAccess.conversation: Gesprek → Open gesprek; existing return link opens the product home

validation.isolatedBrowser: passed: six sections, Back/reload, scoped503, private-source unmount,390px
validation.installedBrowser: passed: six sections, Back/reload,390px, real backend access

usage.note: The last source cleanup rebuilt byte-identical assets; no second installation. Ordinary autonomous Eva usage is separate from this navigation verification.

buildPreparationFailures: The minimal installed image has no cat binary; asset inspection was changed to its existing Python interpreter before installation.

Old asset cleanup initially ran as the nonroot runtime user and was denied; build-only root cleanup was used, restoring exactly the same runtime user. Existing installation remained unchanged until the one successful dispatch.
limitations: This closes product navigation E2.1 only; E2.2 through E2.6 remain open.
Conversation links to the existing bound conversation page with its return link; no new chat engine or voice route was built.
People currently shows the real coarse account/sharing/memory-processing overview and existing own source controls, not a complete person-profile or derived-memory browser.
Initiatives uses existing review/contribution data; full reflection, feedback, candidate, evaluation and applied-improvement history is not yet connected.
Connections shows current real observations; unknown remains unknown. Extra provider/WhatsApp configuration is not available yet.
Browser checks used no paid model/conversation request and no task mutation; navigation proves usable presentation/backend read access, not accepted everyday family use.
